name: safetycatch-browser-extension
description: Browser extension (Chrome, Edge, Firefox) that guards the risky step an attack needs: pasting a hidden command, entering a device code, approving an OAuth app, signing in on a look-alike page, pasting secrets into an AI chat, or opening a risky download.
author: The SafetyCatch Authors

scripts.check: node --run typecheck && node --run test && node --run build
